_doc: Hand-assigned gold labels for scripts/benchmark_ollama_models.py. YES = the filter should fire and the paper is excluded. null = genuinely ambiguous from the abstract alone; excluded from scoring for that filter. Papers are identified by DOI/title rather than shipped with their abstracts, so no publisher text is redistributed - rebuild the sample against your own .bib with --rebuild-sample.
